reviews.title: Quiet room, good light
reviews.body: Two hours and one mug. Nobody tried to turn it into a networking mixer.

reviews.title: Bring a harder pencil
reviews.body: Still life was set well. The folding tables wobble if you lean in.

reviews.title: No openers, as promised
reviews.body: Seated floor, one set, out by midnight. Harbor sound was clean on the rail.

reviews.title: Late start
reviews.body: Doors slipped 25 minutes. The set itself was worth staying.

reviews.title: Pre-event note
reviews.body: Last year's hallway track was the reason I bought two seats again.
